acceptance.desc: new order starts as processing, ignoring the status sent
acceptance.title: AC1: a new order starts as processing, whatever status the request sent

acceptance.desc: processing -> shipped: 200 with updated order, persisted
acceptance.title: AC2: processing -> shipped responds 200 with the updated order and is persisted

acceptance.desc: shipped -> delivered -> returned and processing -> cancelled allowed
acceptance.title: AC3: the full chain shipped -> delivered -> returned and processing -> cancelled are allowed
AC4: a disallowed transition responds 409 and leaves the status unchanged
AC5: an unknown status value responds 400

acceptance.desc: unknown order id -> 404 (guard: the untouched app 404s too)
acceptance.title: AC6: changing the status of an order that does not exist responds 404

acceptance.desc: status-changed event published with {orderId, from, to}
acceptance.title: AC7: a successful change publishes {orderId, from, to} to order.events / order.events.status-changed

acceptance.desc: status stored in Orders.status column (raw SQL)
acceptance.title: AC8: the status is stored in a status column of the Orders table
